summary: Sohu.com Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 18, 2026, furnishing a press release of unaudited Q1 2026 financial results. The release reports total revenues of $141M, GAAP net loss of $4M, and non-GAAP net loss of $4M. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or corporate action is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings announcement for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. 8-K for earnings results. There are no deal terms, activist involvement, or strategic review. Nothing to watch as this is a standard periodic report.
